target_task.text:
Mara,

Below is a consolidated response covering the project framework, editorial approach, companion resources, and next steps.

**Project framework, timing, and terms**

The milestones will proceed sequentially rather than in parallel, with each stage starting only after the preceding one is complete. Milestone 1 will be scheduled within the overall project timeline rather than assigned a separate deadline, and Milestone 3 should also be completed during the allotted project timeline. That third stage will begin when the manuscript work is nearly finished.

Our target for the final manuscript is one month after the project begins, although that date is flexible. Now that the complete requirements and scope are clear, please tell us what schedule would be comfortable for you. The current milestone structure is our preferred arrangement, but you are welcome to propose a different breakdown for discussion. Scheduled review periods will occur throughout the process, during which our editorial team will provide feedback.

The project’s total compensation is $1,200. Our proposal is to divide it equally into three milestones of $400, with each payment tied to completion of that stage’s agreed deliverables. If another milestone structure would work better, we are open to discussing it together.

Once the remaining details are finalized and both parties are ready to proceed, we will send the contract.

**Editorial work for Milestone 1**

We agree that reducing the question set is the right approach. For every question you recommend removing, please include a brief reason. In the Google Doc we shared, delete each proposed removal while using suggesting mode and leave a comment explaining your reasoning. Your current commenting access allows you to make those deletions and attach the explanatory comments, but we cannot provide a downloadable copy at this stage.

After the question list has been settled, we’ll create a separate working manuscript containing only the finalized questions so that subsequent work can focus specifically on them.

For every question, the answer must contain at least two layers: guidance on how to frame the response and a sample answer. The interviewer’s intent, common mistakes, and a framework can be included where relevant, but they will not necessarily apply to every question.

**New chapters and global perspective for Milestone 2**

Rather than assigning the global perspective its own dedicated chapters, it should be integrated naturally into the existing material. For example, a pre-interview checklist may differ between the USA and India, while answer framing may vary between the US and the UK. A short opening note could explain that the book primarily addresses US and Indian readers while also including relevant tips throughout about international differences. We would also be glad to receive your recommendations about other markets worth considering beyond the US and India.

There is no fixed chapter length. As a rough ideal, each chapter may fall between approximately 4k and 6k words, but it can be shorter or somewhat longer when the topic and required depth justify the variation. In an interview-questions book, theory-oriented chapters should generally remain concise.

**Hybrid companion resources for Milestone 3**

Most hybrid resources should be delivered as finished products. Videos are the exception: you may supply the scripts, and we will take care of recording them. You will also need to prepare the templates sufficiently for our production team to build precisely what you intend.

We suggested these resources because we believe they can distinguish the book from competing titles while helping readers learn visually and practically instead of relying exclusively on text. Please recommend any other companion materials you believe would suit this type of book.

If any point remains unclear, please send us your questions. We would also be happy to arrange a call so that we can discuss everything thoroughly and ensure complete alignment.

target_task.text:
Mara,

Until the contract terms are finalized, we will not provide an editable or downloadable version of the manuscript. This keeps the process organized on our side. Once the terms are settled, we will send the PDF so you can begin working ahead.

For clarity, the contract is intended to include the following scope:

**1\. Addition of chapters (5, as discussed earlier)**

The 5 additions will consist of two basic chapters and three question-and-answer chapters.

A. Basic chapters

These should not use a question-and-answer format and should fall within the 4k - 6k range or be shorter.

\--Pre-interview preparation checklist — because the audience is already experienced, this should approach preparation from a leadership perspective rather than repeat the basics. We would especially like to include advice that applies to leadership-level interviews.

\--Using AI for interview preparation, including prompts, techniques, and tools

B. Question & Answers chapters

Within the book’s total word limit, the author may decide how many questions to include in each chapter.

\--Questions a candidate can ask the interviewer

\--Questions aimed specifically at first-time leaders

\--Remote & Hybrid Leadership questions

**2\. Review and update of the existing material**

As agreed in our earlier discussions, the author will review the current content and revise it according to the instructions. This includes streamlining the question set in every existing chapter or category, whether taken from the current edition or the full set of 720 questions. To produce the strongest content, the author may recommend any of the following:

1\. Merge two categories or chapters, or remove a particular one.

2\. Remove individual questions, provided a rationale is supplied.

3\. Add questions to an existing category so the edition reflects what is currently being asked in the workplace.

4\. Introduce a new question category if it is not already covered.

5\. Recommend better wording for questions that could be used more effectively after rephrasing.

\--Develop answers and add answers for new questions, using the agreed 2 mandatory and 2 subjective layers.

1\. Mandatory answer layers: guidance on how to frame the answer, with answer frameworks integrated into that guidance, and a sample answer.

2\. Subjective answer layers: the interviewer’s intent and common mistakes.

No proposed addition or removal of a category, chapter, or question will be implemented until the editorial team has reviewed it properly. As previously discussed, the author will review the entire book—all 720 questions—and provide feedback to the team during the first milestone.

**3\. Hybrid resources**

Because our books are designed to support readers who may not want to read from cover to cover, the manuscript should be accompanied by online resources that create a hybrid learning experience. Possibilities include checklists, AI prompts, body-language videos, mock interviews, answer templates, leadership resume guidance, and any other suitable ideas you may have.

The complete book must remain within an overall limit of 110k words, so the content should be planned around that cap.

You are also welcome to propose other revisions or additions that would make the book more relevant or interactive for its current audience. Those ideas, however, will only be implemented after discussion with the editorial team.

\-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Please confirm that these project requirements are clear and that you are comfortable proceeding on this basis.

Our team is still finalizing the contract and will send it to you for review as soon as it is ready. Thank you for your patience; we look forward to working together and beginning as soon as possible.
